review_candidates.title: Senior Manager, Global Brand Operations
review_candidates.location: Billund, Region of Southern Denmark, Denmark
review_candidates.description: Job Description About the role Global Brand Development (GBD) is looking for an operationally minded marketing leader who brings rigor, clarity, and momentum to how a global brand function delivers its work. If you love turning ambitious brand plans into well-run projects, thrive on making complex work feel simple, and take pride in being the person who keeps everything on track — this role is for you. We offer a hybrid working model called Best of Both three days in our Billund or Copenhagen office and up to two days from home. No relocation assistance is offered for this role. Required Qualifications Significant experience leading complex global marketing, operations, transformation, or portfolio programs. Recognized expertise in program leadership, governance, resource management, and organizational operations. Demonstrated success leading large-scale cross-functional initiatives with significant business impact. Experience establishing and evolving operating models, governance structures, and delivery frameworks. Strong strategic thinking capabilities, with the ability to connect organizational priorities to operational execution. Preferred Qualifications Excellent communication and facilitation skills, including experience advising leadership teams and guiding executive discussions. Proven ability to influence senior leaders and shape decision-making across a complex stakeholder landscape. Demonstrated ability to coach colleagues, strengthen delivery capabilities, and drive continuous improvement at scale. What You'll Build/drive GBD’s operating model Own and continuously evolve the GBD operating model, governance framework, planning processes, and delivery cadences. Ensure ways of working enable the function to execute against strategic priorities while maintaining clarity, alignment, and accountability across teams. Portfolio delivery leadership Provide strategic oversight of the GBD project portfolio, maintaining visibility of priorities, dependencies, risks, resource requirements, and delivery performance. Advise the GBD Leadership Team on portfolio trade-offs, delivery risks, and opportunities to improve organizational effectiveness. Campaign Operations for Global Brand Campaigns Provide leadership for campaign operations across Global Brand Campaigns, partnering with OLA, EP&C, and Brand teams to establish scalable governance, decision-making frameworks, and delivery standards that improve predictability, quality, and performance. Strategic leadership Act as a trusted advisor to the GBD Leadership Team by shaping strategic agendas, enabling decision-making, surfacing organizational risks and opportunities, and ensuring focus on the initiatives that will create the greatest impact. Support enterprise initiatives Lead high-impact cross-functional initiatives that address strategic opportunities, organizational priorities, or business challenges. Define approaches, align stakeholders, and ensure delivery of measurable outcomes in partnership with leaders across the LEGO Group. Build organizational capability Coach teams and project leaders on operational excellence, project governance, prioritization, and delivery best practices. Champion a culture of continuous improvement and accountability across GBD. Life on the team Joining the Global Brand Development team means getting to be a part of steering how we develop our brand in the market, and driving continuous improvement within the business team responsible for navigating that journey. Specifically, this individual will support the key Global Brand Operations responsibilities of Drive continuous improvement identify operational inefficiencies or process gaps, propose & implement optimizations, and build scalable structures to support growth & increasing complexity. Ensure governance, compliance, and clarity of roles and responsibilities when navigating complex scenarios (e.g., xF partnership and campaigns across PGs, EP&C, DCE, OLA, Markets). The team works in a very integrated fashion, as the three components of Global Brand Operations have many interdependencies. These components are Brand Performance and Prioritization, Brand Wiring into the broader LEGO Group, and internal Global Brand Development functional operations. We operate with weekly Global Brand Operations team meetings and monthly Global Brand Development functional meetings. What Success Looks Like Success means your work has helped all GBD team members know how we operate, understand why, and have clarity on the expectations for how we all engage with each other, and with the OLA organization (internal agency). You will have taken a strong outcome focus, understand the external market-facing impact the company is trying to deliver, and recognize that creating structure and leveraging our internal processes are tools to deliver those outcomes. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. However, please note we do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to any advertised closing date. So, if you're interested in this role we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. What’s in it for you? Here is what you can expect Family Care Leave - We offer enhanced paid leave options for those important times. Insurances – All colleagues are covered by our life and disability insurance which provides protection and peace of mind. Wellbeing - We want our people to feel well and thrive. We offer resources and benefits to nurture physical and mental wellbeing along with opportunities to build community and inspire creativity. Colleague Discount – We know you'll love to build, so from day 1 you will qualify for our generous colleague discount. Bonus - We do our best work to succeed together. When goals are reached and if eligible, you'll be rewarded through our bonus scheme. Workplace - When you join the team you'll be assigned a primary workplace location i.e. one of our Offices, stores or factories. Our hybrid work policy means an average of 3 days per week in the office. The hiring team will discuss the policy and role eligibility with you during the recruitment process. Children are our role models. Their curiosity, creativity and imagination inspire everything we do. We strive to create a diverse, dynamic and inclusive culture of play at the LEGO Group, where everyone feels safe, valued and they belong. The LEGO Group is highly committed to equal employment opportunity and equal pay and seeks to encourage applicants from all backgrounds (eg. sex, gender identity or expression, race/ethnicity, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, age and religion) to apply for roles in our team. The LEGO Group is fully committed to Children’s Rights and Child Wellbeing across the globe. Candidates offered positions with high engagement with children are required to take part in Child Safeguarding Background Screening, as a condition of the offer. Thank you for sharing our global commitment to Children’s Rights. Just imagine building your dream career. Then make it real. Join the LEGO® team today.

review_candidates.title: Senior Back-end Engineer - PHP, Node.js
review_candidates.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Back-end Engineer - PHP, Node.js based in Netherlands. As a Senior Back-end Engineer, you’ll help build reliable, scalable systems that power commerce solutions used at global scale. You’ll join a collaborative engineering environment where product thinking is just as important as technical excellence. The role combines hands-on backend development with architectural decision-making, performance optimization, and continuous improvement. You’ll work closely with Product Managers and other stakeholders to turn business needs into impactful technical solutions. With strong ownership over your initiatives, you’ll have the freedom to challenge requirements, prioritize effectively, and influence how solutions are designed and delivered. You’ll also contribute to engineering culture through code reviews, testing, pair programming, and knowledge sharing. This is a fully remote opportunity within EMEA for an experienced engineer who enjoys solving complex problems and working in an evolving environment. Accountabilities Design, develop, test, and ship high-quality backend solutions that are scalable, reliable, maintainable, and aligned with product goals. Work primarily with PHP or Node.js while developing the flexibility and expertise to contribute across both backend ecosystems. Design and improve high-load architectures using distributed systems principles, Domain-Driven Design, CQRS, and modern software engineering practices. Collaborate closely with Product Managers, stakeholders, and fellow engineers to translate business requirements into effective technical solutions. Take end-to-end ownership of technical initiatives, from solution design and prioritization through implementation, testing, deployment, and continuous improvement. Identify technical debt, performance bottlenecks, bugs, and opportunities for platform improvements, prioritizing work according to business and user impact. Contribute to engineering quality through code reviews, refactoring, unit testing, pair programming, and continuous integration and deployment. Troubleshoot complex issues, optimize application performance, and help maintain reliable production systems. Participate in knowledge-sharing sessions, technical discussions, and mentoring opportunities while continuously improving engineering practices. Use AI-assisted development tools and LLMs effectively for architectural exploration, implementation, testing, debugging, documentation, and code quality. Requirements 5+ years of professional backend software development experience with strong proficiency in PHP or Node.js and a willingness to learn and work with the other technology. Strong experience designing and developing high-load systems, distributed architectures, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), and CQRS. Solid understanding of software engineering principles and best practices, including SOLID, Test-Driven Development (TDD), CI/CD, and Agile methodologies. Hands-on experience with backend technologies such as PHP 8.1+, Symfony, Laravel, Yii2, Doctrine, or comparable frameworks and libraries. Experience working with databases and infrastructure technologies such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, AWS, Kubernetes, and Docker. Strong debugging, testing, performance optimization, and problem-solving skills. Product-minded approach, with the ability to prioritize technical work according to business value and user impact rather than technical preference alone. Strong sense of ownership, initiative, and accountability, with the ability to work independently in a fast-changing environment. Good spoken and written English communication skills. Practical experience using LLMs and coding assistants such as Claude or GitHub Copilot to improve development workflows is expected. Strong collaboration skills and willingness to contribute through code reviews, pair programming, knowledge sharing, and cross-functional teamwork. Benefits Fully remote work within eligible EMEA locations, with the option to work from a modern office environment where available. Flexible working hours, allowing you to structure your day around your work and personal commitments. Private health insurance. Two additional paid days off dedicated to mental or physical wellbeing. One additional paid day off for your birthday or another personal celebration of your choice. Access to internal and external learning and professional development opportunities. Mentorship, technical meetups, hackathons, and knowledge-sharing initiatives. Healthy lunch provided when working from the office. Employee merchandise opportunities and discounts. Team-building activities, company events, and social gatherings. Opportunity to work within a global, inclusive, and ambitious engineering organization focused on delivering meaningful commerce solutions. How Jobgether Works We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best! Why Apply Through Jobgether? Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. GulfPlacement provides reliable guidance on work conditions, regulations, and best practices to reduce employment-related risks. By connecting people with accurate information and resources, the platform aims to promote fair, transparent, and secure overseas employment experiences. Role Description The Project Manager role at GulfPlacement is a full-time, on-site position based in Dubai. The Project Manager will plan, execute, and oversee projects related to employment information services, ensuring timely delivery, quality standards, and alignment with organizational goals. Day-to-day responsibilities include coordinating with internal teams and external partners, managing project timelines and budgets, tracking progress, and resolving issues to keep projects on schedule. The role involves preparing reports, maintaining documentation, and communicating project status to stakeholders. The Project Manager will also identify opportunities for process improvements and support strategic initiatives that enhance the platform’s impact and service quality. Proficiency in Logistics Management for coordinating resources, schedules, and workflows across multiple locations. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Management, Engineering, or a related field; advanced certifications in project management (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2) are an advantage. Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving abilities, with attention to detail and accuracy. Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work in diverse, cross-functional teams. Experience in overseas employment, recruitment services, or GCC markets is beneficial. Candidates from India , Nepal , Srilanka can apply. Email: info@gulfplacement.com

review_candidates.title: Project Assistant
review_candidates.description: Job Description Introduction Established in 1951, IOM is a Related Organization of the United Nations and the leading UN agency in the field of migration. Working closely with governmental, intergovernmental and non-governmental partners, IOM promotes humane and orderly migration for the benefit of all. It saves lives and protects people on the move, drives solutions to displacement, and facilitates pathways for regular migration, while providing services and advice to governments and migrants. IOM is committed to fostering a respectful, inclusive and supportive workplace where all employees can thrive professionally and feel valued. By creating such an environment, IOM aims to better harness the full potential of migration and strengthen its support to people on the move. IOM invites candidates from diverse backgrounds to apply and provides reasonable accommodation throughout the recruitment process when required. Learn more about IOM’s workplace culture at IOM workplace culture | International Organization for Migration Applications are welcome from internal and external candidates. For all IOM vacancies, applications from qualified and eligible first-tier candidates are considered before those of qualified and eligible second-tier candidates in the selection process. For the purpose of this vacancy, internal and internal-equivalent candidates are considered as first-tier candidates. Organizational Context and Scope Established in 1951, IOM is the leading inter-governmental organization in the field of migration and works closely with governmental, intergovernmental and nongovernmental partners. IOM is dedicated to promoting humane and orderly migration for the benefit of all. It does so by providing services and advice to governments and migrants. Under the overall supervision of the Chief of Mission (CoM) in Dublin and direct supervision of the National Project Officer the successful candidate will be responsible for the support requirements of the project supporting Beneficiaries of Temporary Protection (BOTP’S) in Ireland. The role will provide administrative support across programme operations, with a primary focus on assisting the team responsible for facilitating movements into transitional accommodation. Responsibilities will include coordinating logistics, maintaining records, supporting case management processes, and ensuring smooth communication between teams. The role will include other programme related responsibilities as required. Responsibilities Support the implementation of the operational strategy of the project aiming to support BOTP’s in Ireland. Support the implementation of project activities and assist caseworkers in accordance with the project's Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Support administrative coordination of project implementation, involving liaison with diverse organizational units and external parties to initiate requests, obtain necessary clearances, process and follow-up on administrative actions, etc. Draft correspondence, reports, briefing notes, graphics, statistical tables, presentations and other forms of documentation. Organize meetings, workshops and training sessions. Respond to general information requests and inquiries; set up and maintain files/records. Maintain and ensure confidentiality of all projects related matters in accordance with guidelines and instructions. Take active steps to mitigate fraud and malfeasance and monitor the integrity of records containing individual data. Perform any other duties as may be assigned Qualifications Required Qualifications and Experience Education School diploma with four years of relevant experience; or, Bachelor’s degree in Political or Social Sciences, International Relations, Development Studies, Migration Studies, Human Rights, Law or related fields from an accredited academic institution with two years of relevant professional experience. Accredited Universities are those listed in the UNESCO World Higher Education Database. Experience Experience in liaising with governmental authorities, national/international institutions, United Nations agencies and non-governmental organizations; Experience in working with migrants, refugees, internally displaced persons, victims of trafficking and other vulnerable groups; and, Prior work experience with international humanitarian organizations, non-government or government institutions/organization in a multi-cultural setting is an advantage. Skills In depth knowledge of the broad range of migration related subject areas dealt with by the Organization; and, Knowledge of UN and bilateral donor programming. Knowledge of financial rules and regulations. Languages All IOM staff members in all categories are required to be fluent in one of the IOM's official languages (English, French, Spanish). For this position, fluency in English is required (oral and written). Working knowledge of Arabic is desirable. Proficiency of language(s) required will be specifically evaluated during the selection process, which may include written and/or oral assessments. Required Competencies IOM’s competency framework can be found at this link . Competencies will be assessed during the selection process. Values - all IOM staff members must abide by and demonstrate these five values: Inclusion and respect for diversity: Respects and promotes individual and cultural differences. Encourages diversity and inclusion. Integrity and transparency: Maintains high ethical standards and acts in a manner consistent with organizational principles/rules and standards of conduct. Professionalism: Demonstrates ability to work in a composed, competent and committed manner and exercises careful judgment in meeting day-to-day challenges. Courage: Demonstrates willingness to take a stand on issues of importance. Empathy: Shows compassion for others, makes people feel safe, respected and fairly treated. Core Competencies – behavioural indicators Level 1 Teamwork: Develops and promotes effective collaboration within and across units to achieve shared goals and optimize results. Delivering results: Produces and delivers quality results in a service-oriented and timely manner. Is action oriented and committed to achieving agreed outcomes. Managing and sharing knowledge: Continuously seeks to learn, share knowledge and innovate. Accountability: Takes ownership for achieving the Organization’s priorities and assumes responsibility for own actions and delegated work. Communication: Encourages and contributes to clear and open communication. Explains complex matters in an informative, inspiring and motivational way. Notes Please refer to this link for guidance on IOM Job Category. Any offer made to the candidate in relation to this vacancy notice is subject to funding confirmation. This selection process may be used to staff similar positions in various duty stations. Recommended candidates will remain eligible to be appointed in a similar position for a period of 24 months. Appointment will be subject to certification that the candidate is medically fit for appointment, accreditation, any residency or visa requirements, security clearances. This post is subject to local recruitment. Only those holding a valid residence and work permit for the country where this position is based will be eligible for consideration. As the right to live and work in Ireland is required, the contract issued may be shorter that the period mentioned in the advertisement, in order to align with the expiry date of the work permit. IOM has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and IOM, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and discrimination based on gender, nationality, age, race, sexual orientation, religious or ethnic background or disabilities. IOM does not charge a fee at any stage of its recruitment process (application, interview, processing, training or other fee). IOM does not request any information related to bank accounts. IOM only accepts duly completed applications submitted through the IOM e-Recruitment system (for internal candidates link here ). The online tool also allows candidates to track the status of their application. No late applications will be accepted. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. For further information and other job postings, you are welcome to visit our website: IOM Careers and Job Vacancies

review_candidates.title: Project Administrator
review_candidates.description: PROJECT ADMINISTRATOR Keep Projects Moving. Keep People Aligned. Make Things Happen. Are you an organised, driven and detail focused Project Administrator who thrives in a fast paced technology environment? Do you enjoy being the person who keeps projects moving, makes sure nothing falls through the cracks, and brings structure to complex, multidisciplinary projects? We are looking for a Project Administrator to join our team and play a key role in supporting the successful delivery of projects within the Telecoms and IT environment. This is more than an administration role. You will be at the centre of project coordination, working with Project Managers, vendors, stakeholders and internal teams to ensure projects progress efficiently, documentation is accurate, costs are managed and customer expectations are met. What You Will Be Responsible For Analyse financial records and costing models, using your judgement to determine whether projects should proceed based on cost and commercial considerations. Communicate with personnel and vendors regarding project issues, provide updates and resolve problems where possible, knowing when an issue needs to be escalated to the relevant Project Manager. Create and manage work orders on Forcelink, assigning work to the appropriate vendors and ensuring all required documentation is correctly uploaded. Receive and verify invoices and delivery notes, and sign off quotations for completed projects and recoveries. Prepare progress reports and provide regular updates to stakeholders, including the PMO. Extract relevant information from Forcelink and provide vendors with the data required for follow ups and project completion. Maintain accurate project folders and ensure all project documentation is uploaded and up to date. Monitor projects and recoveries by generating work in progress reports, ensuring projects are progressing and completed within the required SLA. Schedule and document stakeholder meetings, ensuring that decisions, actions and responsibilities are followed through. Update and close all projects on MSPI. What We Are Looking For Matric, essential Relevant higher qualification Project Management certification, advantageous At least 2 years of proven Project Administration experience supporting multidisciplinary projects within the Telecoms or IT environment, essential Experience supporting multiple projects simultaneously A strong understanding of general Telecoms principles, with RF or wireless knowledge being desirable Excellent written and verbal communication skills Strong interpersonal and stakeholder engagement skills A collaborative, team-oriented approach Strong organisational skills and the ability to prioritise effectively The ability to multitask and work comfortably in a fast-paced environment A high level of drive, ownership and accountability A goal-driven approach with a strong focus on delivery A genuine commitment to prioritising customer needs WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS The best project teams are not only built around great Project Managers. They are supported by people who bring structure, visibility, accountability and momentum to every project. As the Project Administrator, you will have a direct impact on how efficiently projects move from planning to execution to completion . If you are someone who takes ownership, spots problems before they become bigger issues, enjoys working with people and takes pride in getting the details right, this could be your next opportunity. READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT? If you are ready to take your Project Administration experience into an environment where your contribution is visible and valued, we would love to hear from you.
